jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Overview:

The **Enterprise Solution Architect (ESA)** is the senior technical leader responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise architecture for a large-scale healthcare supply chain and logistics portfolio.

The ESA leads the sustainment and modernization of legacy business applications, inventory systems, procurement systems, financial management integrations, enterprise data capabilities, and shared digital services. This role establishes the architecture for a centralized integration platform that enables secure, scalable, governed, and near-real-time information exchange across supply chain, logistics, clinical, financial, asset-management, and external partner systems.

The ESA serves as the core technical leader responsible for planning, designing, and governing next-generation autonomous, goal-driven AI systems that support supply-chain modernization, operational decision-making, workflow optimization, enterprise data exchange, and intelligent automation.

This position balances continuity of mission-critical operations with deliberate, phased modernization. The ESA ensures that architecture decisions improve interoperability, data quality, cybersecurity, resiliency, maintainability, delivery velocity, and readiness for future digital capabilities.

This is a critical technical leadership role responsible for enabling a secure, integrated, resilient, and modern healthcare supply-chain ecosystem. The Enterprise Solution Architect protects current operational capabilities while establishing the architecture, governance, integration foundation, data discipline, modernization pathway, and intelligent automation capabilities required for future enterprise transformation.

jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Lead Software Engineer for MinuteClinic will play a pivotal role in driving the next generation of clinical and patient-facing technology for millions of users. You will lead the design, development, and delivery of modern, scalable software solutions as we re-platform our entire technology stack and embrace AI-enabled engineering practices.

In this role, you will set technical direction, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with product, design, and architecture partners to deliver solutions that improve patient care and empower clinical staff. You will be expected to take initiative, identify opportunities to accelerate development, and champion engineering excellence across the team.

As a self-motivated leader with a passion for continued learning, you will proactively adopt new technologies, evaluate emerging tools—including AI-driven development—and inspire the team to innovate while maintaining a high bar for quality, performance, and reliability.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years in a technical leadership or mentoring role.
* Proven experience designing and building backend services, APIs, or distributed systems in a cloud environment (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Strong understanding of architectural principles, system design, and engineering best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership, drive initiatives from concept to delivery, and remove ambiguity through action
